Each analysis lives in `analysis/<YY>_<MM>_<DD>_<topic>/` with a `SUMMARY.md` whose YAML
front matter supplies the `title`, `date` and `description` below. This index is built
from that front matter — **nothing here needs editing when an analysis is added.** Write
good front matter instead; `description` is the headline and carries the actual numeric
conclusion. See [`README.md`](README.md) for the conventions.
